limitations: Revision is caller-supplied provenance; imported file hashes bind actual source bytes.
Disposable Node SQLite prototype; no shared production source edits.
Tag sidecar is synchronously maintained by this fixture adapter only; every real writer/import/restore must participate before adoption.

Token-sidecar population is included in fixture setup, not reviewer query timing. Write measurements compare naive replacement against raw item update, not full production registry writes or on-disk WAL.
Fast reviewer timings use IN-subquery lookup, which can materialize all matching token IDs; bounded raw-key timings are separately listed under boundedMeasurements.
Cursor is an experiment rowid checkpoint; production needs authorization/selection/revision binding and restart-on-change behavior.
Result equivalence uses the current exact resolver/review-basis implementation, including its inherited behavior.
